text: ok it works. problem is that it does not save/store. i paint anything -> change page -> come back its all gone
resolution: FIXED + user-confirmed. Studio paint persistence was broken across model-switch and restart because STUDIO_PAINT_KEY is ONE shared GPU texture restored only once per model per session: switching models left the prior model's pixels in the texture, an unpainted model's base-coat wiped it, and on restart the gate plus async paintRef arrival skipped the restore. Diagnosed via the durable store (modelPaintBaked blobs were present and valid — save always worked; restore was the bug). Replaced the once-per-session gate with a load tracker (model id + whether a blob was loaded) that reloads the shared texture whenever the open model changes or its blob first arrives async, base-coats only a genuinely unpainted model, never reloads our own just-saved strokes (commitPaint advances the tracker; savePaint returns the ref) or mid-stroke, and resets on unmount. Keyed by a new sceneId prop since model names repeat.
